event: 2026 ILCA 4 Youth European Championship and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: ESP 226191 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: GRE 214206 and ESP 226191 were sailing on a run.
GRE 214206 was clear ahead on starboard tack, while ESP 226191 was on port tack.
The boats were on converging courses.
When the distance between the boats was 30 cms, GRE 214206 bore away, while ESP 226191 continued to hold her course.
conclusions: ESP 226191 on port tack failed to keep clear of GRE 214206 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
